traditions.p: Middle Ages (tanning, scented gloves) to present
traditions.d: The Provençal town that grew from glove tanning into the centre of French perfume raw materials and manufacture.
traditions.tech: cold enfleurage of dawn-picked flowers; essential oils, concretes, absolutes, resinoids and molecular distillation
traditions.mat: jasmine (from the 16th century), rose, lavender, myrtle, orange blossom, mimosa
traditions.auth: Grasse-grown flower materials are scarce (under 30 tonnes of flowers a year by 2000), so origin claims need documentation.

notes: Old k1 "Alcohol-based perfume" became Floral fragrance; its ~70 models were redistributed: icons became archetypes (Portrait of a Lady, 1 Million, Diptyque Philosykos/Tam Dao/Do Son/Fleur de Peau), notable house scents stay as flat models in the family kinds (Diptyque range split by family; Tom Ford, Byredo, Penhaligon's, Kilian, Margiela Replica, Jo Malone, designer releases). Dropped as celebrity/micro-indie/SKU noise with no standing: 19-69 American Psycho, Billie Eilish Your Turn, Caeleste, DedCool (x2), Heretic, House of Mammoth, LBTY, Lore, Maya Njie, Octavia Morgan, OrdioLab, Param Sara, Phlox, Premiere Peau, Rare Beauty, Rivendare, SIAM1928, Soulvent, TALE, TERRA•T, Tory Burch, Vacation, Veronique Gabai, Victoria Beckham, YSL Babycat/MYSLF, Ralph Lauren Polo '67, L'Artisan 33 Abyssae, Diptyque Eau Nabati/Eau Rihla/Tempo/Volutes. Family placement of the flat models follows their names/house notes (to verify against a reference DB). Fragrantica and Parfumo returned HTTP 403 (bot wall) and were not worked around, so the axis is Michael Edwards's wheel via Wikipedia and Wikipedia's List of perfumes (house/year/perfumer). Left out for lack of a retrievable source: Amouage and Lattafa signature scents as archetypes, Baccarat Rouge 540 named clones, Miss Dior/Habit Rouge own pages, Aventus flankers, Molecule 01 launch year, CK One year. Perfumers are entered in the brands file with seg "Perfumer".
